t: 对盖伊·福克斯等阴谋者的审判开始,于1月31日被处决.
te: The trial of Guy Fawkes and other conspirators begins, ending with their execution on January 31.
dz: 火药地块:对盖伊·福克斯等阴谋者的审判开始,于1月31日被处决.
de: Gunpowder Plot: The trial of Guy Fawkes and other conspirators begins, ending with their execution on January 31.

te: Four of the conspirators, including Guy Fawkes, are executed for treason by hanging, drawing and quartering, for plotti…
dz: 火药地块:包括盖伊·福克斯在内的4名阴谋者被以上吊,绘画和扎营等罪名处死,罪名是阴谋反对议会和詹姆斯国王.
de: Gunpowder Plot: Four of the conspirators, including Guy Fawkes, are executed for treason by hanging, drawing and quartering, for plotting against Parliament and King James.

te: The Janszoon voyage of 1605–06 becomes the first European expedition to set foot on Australia, although it is mistaken …
dz: 1605–06年的扬斯宗出航成为了第一个踏上澳大利亚的欧洲远征军,尽管这被误认为是新几内亚的一部分.
de: The Janszoon voyage of 1605–06 becomes the first European expedition to set foot on Australia, although it is mistaken as a part of New Guinea.

de: The Virginia Company of London is established by royal charter by James I of England with the purpose of establishing colonial settlements in North America.

t: 联盟旗被采用为英国和苏格兰船只的旗帜.
te: The Union Flag is adopted as the flag of English and Scottish ships.
dz: 联盟旗被采用为英国和苏格兰船只的旗帜.
de: The Union Flag is adopted as the flag of English and Scottish ships.

te: The ships Susan Constant, Godspeed, and Discovery depart England carrying settlers who founded, at Jamestown, Virginia,…
dz: 苏珊·康斯坦特号(Susan Constantin),"神速"号和"发现"号(Discovery)等舰载着定居者离开英国,他们在弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦建立了成为美国的十三个殖民地中的第一座.
de: The ships Susan Constant, Godspeed, and Discovery depart England carrying settlers who founded, at Jamestown, Virginia, the first of the thirteen colonies that became the United States.
